title: Nellie Introduces Enchiridion

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: As if reality has slipped out from under you between one step and another?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As if reality has slipped out from under you between one step and another?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: What? Yes, sorry. I was up all night reading about the Enchiridion. Now I can't seem to think of anything else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? Yes, sorry. I was up all night reading about the Enchiridion. Now I can't seem to think of anything else.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: The Nivalis Enchiridion. People think it was... a kind of street atlas, written in ancient pictorial Nivali signs, by people who used the old network.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Nivalis Enchiridion. People think it was... a kind of street atlas, written in ancient pictorial Nivali signs, by people who used the old network.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Have you been reading about the Enchiridion too?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you been reading about the Enchiridion too?!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Oh, it was so much more than a street atlas! The stories say that it didn't just show THIS Nivalis, but ALL Nivalis. Every possible version of it across different realities.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it was so much more than a street atlas! The stories say that it didn't just show THIS Nivalis, but ALL Nivalis. Every possible version of it across different realities.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: There's substantial evidence! According to legend, people once accessed the Enchiridion via terminals on every street corner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's substantial evidence! According to legend, people once accessed the Enchiridion via terminals on every street corner.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: According to legend, people once accessed the Enchiridion via terminals on every street corner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: According to legend, people once accessed the Enchiridion via terminals on every street corner.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: So that people could find their way around the city. And if they used the right symbols, they could also travel between all possible cities...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So that people could find their way around the city. And if they used the right symbols, they could also travel between all possible cities...

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: So I can restore the code! See if there’s any truth to the stories!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I can restore the code! See if there’s any truth to the stories!

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Thank you so much! I can't exactly pay you for your time. But I could trade…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you so much! I can't exactly pay you for your time. But I could trade…

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I don’t have much money. But I could trade…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don’t have much money. But I could trade…

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: I'll tell you a secret for every piece you find. In Nivalis, information can be worth more than Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell you a secret for every piece you find. In Nivalis, information can be worth more than Lims.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Apparently during the CorpWars, the last antique Enchiridion terminals were destroyed. I've been searching for them for years, and found a few fragments, but I need more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apparently during the CorpWars, the last antique Enchiridion terminals were destroyed. I've been searching for them for years, and found a few fragments, but I need more.

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: Do you ever get that feeling of deja vu? Like something has changed but you can’t say what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you ever get that feeling of deja vu? Like something has changed but you can’t say what?

nodes.speaker: Nellie Al-Zahiri
nodes.text: The Nivalis Enchiridion. People think it was... a kind of street atlas, written in ancient pictorial Nivali signs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Nivalis Enchiridion. People think it was... a kind of street atlas, written in ancient pictorial Nivali signs.
All the time.
Are you feeling OK, Nellie?
Enchir-what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're excited about a street atlas?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're excited about a street atlas?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're excited about a street atlas?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're excited about a street atlas?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Woah.
Yeah, right.
What for?
Sounds incredible.
Sounds dangerous.
I'm listening...
Not interested, sorry.
You've got a deal.
I'll keep an eye out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I found some fragments... what would be in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I found some fragments... what would be in it for me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I found some fragments... what would be in it for me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I found some fragments... what would be in it for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?
What?
I don't remember.
